name: Cloisonne Tripod
details: An antique-style Cloisonne Tripod vessel captured in a stunning 3D format, showcasing ancient decorative artwork and historic metalwork techniques. This model replicates the classic enamel decoration where metallic wires form intricate patterns filled with vibrant colored pastes, set against a polished bronze base. The digital asset features rich texture maps that realistically simulate metallic sheen, glossy enamel surfaces, and minor signs of historical aging, offering an authentic virtual museum experience. Optimized systematically for mobile AR devices, the polygon count is kept low while preserving sharp visual details and complex geometric silhouettes. Users can inspect the unique tripod legs, ornate side handles, and traditional motifs from all angles. It is a brilliant addition for historical archives, educational applications, and interactive cultural exhibitions, providing fast download speeds and smooth 60fps interaction on the InfoScan app.
